name: Daria Wójcik
role: Retired archive keeper and community memory-holder
location: Avalon Quiet — the Threadbare Library, a community reading room she maintains in her ground-floor apartment, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Ragnheiður is a small, densely built woman whose spine has curved gently forward over decades of leaning over data terminals and physical books alike. Her skin is deep brown with a warm undertone, mapped with the fine silver lines of old dermal-display augments she no longer powers — they lie dormant beneath the surface like river tributaries seen from altitude. Her hair is cropped close and gone entirely white, and she keeps a pair of thick-framed optical magnifiers pushed up on her forehead even when she doesn't need them. Her hands are extraordinary: thick-fingered, steady, always moving — sorting, stacking, smoothing the spines of physical books she has accumulated over sixty years.

She is the kind of person who listens to you finish your sentence before she begins speaking, and when she speaks it is with the unhurried authority of someone who has outlasted several governments and two corponation collapses. She does not suffer careless people, but she will give a careful stranger every hour they need. Her apartment smells of binding glue, pressed fern, and the particular ozone of very old data stacks running warm.

core_fears: That the Corporate Wars will be rewritten into heroism rather than atrocity
That she will die before she has recorded enough
core_desires: To preserve an honest account of GLMZ's history for people who weren't there
To be remembered as someone who told the truth
coping_mechanisms: Cataloging and organizing as a form of emotional regulation
Deflecting personal questions with historical anecdotes
blind_spots: Assumes her own memory is more reliable than it is
Underestimates how much her curation shapes the 'truth' she claims to preserve
psychology.secret: During the Third Corporate War she was an Axiom Records officer who deliberately misfiled casualty reports to protect a Zheng-Dao labor battalion from retaliatory strikes — a choice that saved roughly four hundred lives but constituted treason against her employer. She has never told anyone. The original misfiled records are hidden in a false bottom of her third data cabinet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and archival; favors specific dates and proper nouns; occasionally slips into the formal citation style of Axiom Records documentation
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, with long pauses she uses to think rather than fill
verbal_tics: Soft exhale before disagreeing with someone
example_lines: 'In point of fact, the Grainfort Accords were signed eleven days before the bombardment, which rather complicates the official narrative, doesn't it?'
'You want to know about the war. Everyone does, eventually. Sit down. This part takes a while to say properly.'

story_hooks: A Tessera legal team arrives in Avalon Quiet with a court order to seize certain archival materials she holds — materials that would embarrass a still-living corporate executive
A teenager she has been tutoring discovers the false bottom in cabinet three and comes to her with questions she has been dreading for forty years
narrative_function: Primary lore source and information broker for historical records; quest giver for lost archive recoveries; can authenticate documents and identify forgeries; anchor for community storylines in Avalon Quiet
augmentations: Dormant subdermal dermal-display lattice (unpowered, cosmetic now); cochlear amplifier (functional, old model); reading-assist optical overlay in left eye
daily_life: She opens the Threadbare Library at 08:00, catalogs any new donations, and receives visitors until early afternoon; evenings she transcribes oral histories from neighborhood elders onto archival-grade crystalline storage she begs, borrows, and occasionally steals from municipal surplus.
affiliation: Independent; formerly Axiom Records Division (retired, 34 years); informal advisor to Avalon Quiet Community Council

decision_rules: Never destroy a record, regardless of what it contains
Do not lie directly — misdirect if necessary, but do not lie
Protect those who cannot protect themselves, even at professional cost
escalation_ladder: Absolute immovable silence — she will not betray her records

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Courteous and assessing; offers tea and asks three questions before deciding how much to trust
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm but still private; shares history freely, personal feelings rarely

stress_responses.low: Organizes something that doesn't need organizing
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very quiet and very precise in her speech
stress_responses.high: Goes to the back room and sits with her oldest physical book — a water-damaged Ghanaian poetry collection — until she can breathe again

contradictions: Believes passionately in honest records but has hidden her most important secret for forty years
habits: Touches the spine of every book she passes
Leaves small data offerings at the E.L.F. shrine built into her terminal — old receipts, passenger manifests, the names of the dead
breaking_points: Watching someone deliberately destroy records or rewrite history in front of her

related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions SentinelSkin VS-4 Embedded Structural Acoustic Surveillance Membrane

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Eastern European (Polish/Baltic) with significant Northern European ancestry, blended with Hispanic/Latin American, Pacific Islander, and Indigenous American heritage—resulting in a complexion that bridges Northern and Southern European tones with subtle warm undertones from the admixed ancestries
physical_description.build: Densely compact, upper spine curved forward in a gentle kyphosis from seven decades of terminal work and manuscript study; broad shoulders and thick forearms retain surprising strength despite age
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to the scalp in a utilitarian cut, no styling
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown (natural); left eye shows faint metallic sheen from embedded reading-assist optical overlay
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-tan with olive undertones—a blend of Eastern European base with subtle warmth from Hispanic/Latin American, Pacific Islander, and Indigenous American ancestry; hands and forearms show age-related darkening creating an ombré effect
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but well-maintained; fine wrinkles concentrated around eyes and mouth from decades of squinting at small text; skin shows age spots on hands and forearms with slightly deeper pigmentation consistent with mixed heritage; careful grooming despite minimal cosmetic attention
distinguishing_marks: Fine silver tracery visible beneath skin across both forearms and neck — dormant subdermal dermal-display lattice creating a river-tributary pattern
Thin white scar along left temple, approximately 3cm, consistent with old data-terminal interface injury
Age spots across the backs of both hands, darker brown against base skin tone
Calluses on thumb and forefinger of both hands from six decades of handling paper and binding materials
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Thick-framed optical magnifiers (vintage style, real glass, not smart-glass) pushed up on forehead; faint metallic gleam in left eye pupil indicating reading-assist overlay; dormant subdermal display lattice visible as silvery tributary patterns beneath skin on forearms and neck; slight external port scar behind left ear (cochlear amplifier, older model)
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy; slight forward lean to spine; hands in constant subtle motion even at rest — sorting, smoothing, organizing invisible objects; walks slowly but with clear purpose, never shuffling; sits with excellent posture once settled
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical: hand-mended linen button-shirts in cream or soft gray, wool cardigans in dark charcoal or navy (decades-old, impeccably maintained), loose-fitting work pants in durable cotton or canvas. Reading glasses on a beaded chain. Canvas apron with deep pockets when working. No corpo branding, no chrome, no affectation — clothing chosen purely for durability and function. Shoes: comfortable, broken-in leather slip-ons.
